assertions.name: posts survive, and the post deleted on 0.3.39 is gone
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post

assertions.name: the draft stays a draft
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post WHERE status = 'draft'

assertions.name: every post is in the search index
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post_fts

assertions.name: every post's thread root exists
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post p LEFT JOIN post root ON root.site_id = p.site_id AND root.id = p.thread_id WHERE root.id IS NULL

assertions.name: collections survive
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM collection

assertions.name: post memberships become one per Thread and collection
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection

assertions.name: a reply's collection becomes its Thread's
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection tc JOIN post root ON root.site_id = tc.site_id AND root.id = tc.thread_id JOIN collection c ON c.site_id = tc.site_id AND c.id = tc.collection_id WHERE root.title = 'A Thread' AND c.title = 'Ratings'

assertions.name: thread collection targets are roots
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection tc INNER JOIN post root ON root.site_id = tc.site_id AND root.id = tc.thread_id WHERE root.reply_to_id IS NOT NULL OR root.thread_id <> root.id

assertions.name: the per-post membership table is removed
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'post_collection'

assertions.name: the collections directory survives, divider included
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM collection_directory_item

assertions.name: paths survive, less the deleted post's
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM path_registry

assertions.name: collections move from /c/ to the root
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM path_registry WHERE collection_id IS NOT NULL AND path LIKE 'c/%'

assertions.name: media survives: two images, a text file, a PDF, and a text attachment
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM media

assertions.name: navigation survives
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM nav_item

contains: This post lives at a path
